guides.title: How Much Does Pest Control Cost in Nairobi? A 2026 Price Guide
guides.desc: What fumigation and pest control cost in Nairobi, from KSh 3,500 to KSh 25,000, what changes the price and how to prepare your home.
guides.answer: Pest control in Nairobi typically costs between KSh 3,500 and KSh 25,000. Small cockroach or ant jobs are at the low end, while termites and large bed bug infestations cost more. The pest, the size of the property and the number of visits decide the price.

p: The first factor is the pest. Cockroaches and ants in one kitchen are quick to treat with gel baits. Bed bugs need treatment of mattresses, bed frames and cracks. Termites need soil treatment around the building. Rodents need bait stations and a check of how they get in.

The second factor is size: a bedsitter, a three-bedroom house and a restaurant kitchen are very different jobs. The third is the number of visits, because some pests need a follow-up treatment to break the breeding cycle.

Clear the areas to be treated, cover or store food, and remove pets, fish tanks and children from the property for the time the technician advises. Wash bedding at a high temperature before bed bug treatment.
After the treatment, air the rooms and wipe food-contact surfaces. Do not mop treated floors until the technician says so, because that can remove the product.

Seal gaps around pipes and doors, fix leaks, keep food in closed containers and take out rubbish daily. Rental hosts should inspect mattresses and furniture between guests. A regular service for restaurants and Airbnbs costs less than repeated emergency treatments.

faqs.q: Is a pre-inspection really needed?
faqs.a: Yes. It lets the technician identify the pest and plan the right treatment, so you pay for what works.

faqs.q: What does the 90-day guarantee cover?
faqs.a: If the same pest returns in the treated area within 90 days, we treat it again. Terms are confirmed in your quote.

guides.title: Solar System Cost in Kenya: What to Budget for Home and Farm
guides.desc: A plain guide to solar installation prices in Kenya, from KSh 15,000 to KSh 250,000 and more, and how to size panels, inverter and batteries.
guides.answer: A solar installation in Kenya ranges from about KSh 15,000 for small setups to KSh 250,000 and more for large homes, farms and commercial systems. Battery capacity and system size drive most of the cost.

sections.h: Start with what you want to power
p: List your appliances, their watts and the hours you use them each day. Lights and a TV need little. A fridge runs all day, and pumps, irons and water heaters draw heavy power. This list sets the size of the panels, the inverter and the battery.

Batteries are usually the largest cost, followed by panels and the inverter. Labour, mounting frames, cables, breakers and earthing complete the bill. A system built with protection and good wiring costs more upfront but avoids fires, failures and early battery damage.

Off-grid farms need enough battery to run through the night and cloudy days. Hybrid systems use the grid and batteries together, which suits homes with frequent outages. We explain which type fits your budget before you commit.
Dust on panels, loose connections and tired batteries lower output. Cleaning and a yearly check keep the system healthy.

faqs.q: Can I start small and add later?
faqs.a: Often yes, if the inverter and wiring are chosen with growth in mind. Tell us your future plans and we design for them.

faqs.q: How long does installation take?
faqs.a: Small systems can be installed in a day. Larger systems take longer depending on mounting and wiring.

Cover entrances, gates, parking, stores and blind corners. Mount cameras high enough to be out of easy reach and angled to avoid direct sunlight, which washes out the picture.
The recorder decides how many days of footage you keep. More cameras and higher resolution need bigger storage. Remote viewing needs a stable internet connection at the site.
Electric fencing deters entry along walls and gates, and smart locks remove the risk of lost keys. They work best together with cameras that record what happens at the entry points.

faqs.q: How many cameras does a house need?

faqs.q: Is CCTV footage admissible if something happens?

Fixed brackets sit flat and suit eye-level viewing. Tilting brackets help when the TV is higher. Full motion brackets let you swing the screen but need a stronger wall. Always match the bracket to the screen size and weight.
Mount the centre of the screen close to eye level when seated. Hide cables in the wall or in trunking to keep the room neat and prevent tripping or tugging on the connectors.

guides.title: Farm Spraying in Kenya: Safe Application, Timing and Cost
guides.desc: A practical guide to spraying crops safely in Kenya, how to follow the label and what spraying and crop advice cost, from KSh 4,500 to KSh 35,000.
guides.answer: Farm spraying and crop advice in Kenya costs about KSh 4,500 to KSh 35,000 depending on farm size and crop. Safe spraying means diagnosing first, following the label dose and respecting the waiting period before harvest.

p: Yellow leaves can come from disease, insects, nutrient shortage or too much water. Spraying a fungicide on an insect problem wastes money. A farm visit or clear photos help identify the cause.

The label gives the dose, the crops the product is meant for, the mixing method and the days to wait before harvest. Using more does not work better and can burn the crop or leave residues. Wear gloves, a mask and long clothing when mixing and spraying.

Spray early in the morning or late afternoon when wind is light and it is cooler. Avoid spraying before rain, which washes the product off. Rotate products with different modes of action to slow resistance.

faqs.q: Can I mix two chemicals in one tank?
faqs.a: Only if the labels allow it. Some mixtures damage crops or reduce effect, so ask us before mixing.

faqs.q: Do you supply the chemicals?
faqs.a: Yes. Our catalogue includes crop protection products and plant inputs, and we recommend what suits your crop.

guides.title: Appliance Repair or Replace? A Nairobi Guide for Fridges and Washing Machines
guides.desc: When to repair and when to replace a fridge, washing machine, microwave or oven in Nairobi, plus typical repair costs from KSh 2,500 to KSh 12,000.
guides.answer: Repair if the fault is a low-cost part and the appliance is otherwise sound. Repairs in Nairobi range from KSh 2,500 to KSh 12,000. Replace when the repair cost approaches the price of a new appliance.

sections.h: Common faults and what they mean
p: A fridge that runs but does not cool may have a failed fan, thermostat or sealed system problem. A washing machine that will not drain often has a blocked pump or hose. Microwaves that run but do not heat can have a failed component that needs a technician, never a home fix.

Ask what the repair costs compared with a new unit, how old the appliance is and whether parts are available. If the repair is a small part on a well-made machine, repair wins. If the repair is a major part on a very old machine, replacing may save money.

sections.h: Extend the life of your appliances
p: Clean fridge coils and door seals, run washing machine cleaning cycles, avoid overloading and use a voltage protector if your area has power surges.

faqs.q: Do you charge for diagnosis?
faqs.a: We confirm any diagnosis charge in your quote before the visit.

faqs.q: Can I fix a microwave myself?
faqs.a: No. Microwaves store dangerous electrical charge even when unplugged, so leave repairs to a technician.

guides.title: Deep Cleaning Checklist for Nairobi Homes and Move-Out Cleans
guides.desc: A room-by-room deep cleaning checklist for Nairobi homes, and what professional cleaning costs, from KSh 4,000 to KSh 20,000.
guides.answer: Professional deep cleaning in Nairobi costs about KSh 4,000 to KSh 20,000 depending on size and dirt level. A proper deep clean covers kitchen grease, bathroom limescale, floors, carpets, sofas and mattresses.

p: Degrease the cooker hood, oven, tiles and cupboards. In bathrooms, remove limescale from taps, showers and tiles and disinfect toilets and drains.
Scrub tile grout, vacuum and extract carpets and rugs, and clean sofas with extraction machines to lift dirt from deep in the fabric. Mattresses benefit from sanitation to reduce dust and odour.
Move-out cleans help tenants get deposits back. Move-in cleans give you a fresh start. After construction, cement dust and paint splashes need special removal before the home is safe to live in.

faqs.q: How often should I deep clean?
faqs.a: Most homes benefit from a deep clean once or twice a year, and before and after moving.

faqs.q: Do I need to be at home?
faqs.a: Not necessarily, but it helps to be available at the start and the end to point out priorities and check the result.

guides.title: Water Heater Installation, Leaks and Tripping Breakers: A Nairobi Homeowner Guide
guides.desc: What to do about leaks, tripping breakers and water heater installation in Nairobi, plus typical costs from KSh 2,000 to KSh 15,000.
guides.answer: Electrical and plumbing repairs in Nairobi cost about KSh 2,000 to KSh 15,000 depending on the job. Fix leaks early, never keep resetting a tripping breaker and have water heaters installed with correct wiring and earthing.

p: A small drip can waste thousands of litres and damage walls. A rising water bill without more usage can point to a hidden leak. Turn off the water at the main and call a plumber instead of waiting for damage.
Breakers trip to protect you. Repeated tripping signals an overload, a faulty appliance or damaged wiring. Unplug appliances, reset once and call an electrician if it trips again.
Instant heaters draw heavy current and need a suitable cable, a dedicated breaker and proper earthing. A poor installation can overheat wires. Always have the work tested before use.

faqs.q: Can I install a water heater myself?
faqs.a: We advise against it. Wrong cable size or missing earthing creates a fire and shock risk, so use a qualified technician.

faqs.q: Do you handle emergency calls?
faqs.a: Message us on WhatsApp with the problem and location and we advise on the fastest visit available.
